thread:
maya: quick copy pass on a few tiny things i spotted in the console. want to sync before i open PRs.

conor: yep, hit me.

maya: 1) 'Token burn rate' tooltip in the job run view is quite mathy: currently says 'tokens/sec averaged over a minute window'. feels terse and a bit opaque.

evan: +1. users care about cost impact and spikes. maybe mention cost or short spikes.

maya: my draft: "Tokens burned per second (1-minute avg). Use this to spot short bursts that increase cost."

anya: that's clear but a bit long for a tooltip. component rule: tooltips aim for ~90 chars. design-bot: reminder: tooltip length target 90-110 chars for readability.

conor: shorter option: "Shown as a 1-minute avg to reveal short bursts in token usage." (72 chars)

evan: i like 'reveal' — it's active. also add aria-label exactly matching copy.

maya: agreed. final: "Shown as a 1-minute avg to reveal short bursts in token usage." I'll add to both job view and the billing mini-card.

maya: 2) scheduled jobs empty state: currently reads 'No scheduled jobs'. can we make it more actionable? suggestion: "No scheduled jobs yet. Create a routine to run tests, refresh datasets, or export metrics."

conor: maybe trim: "No scheduled jobs yet. Create one to run tests, refresh data, or export metrics."

anya: also suggest adding a button in the empty state: 'Create job' — but that's a separate design change. copy-only ok for now.

evan: product approves the trimmed version. add a small hint link: 'Learn about jobs' (links to docs) in the empty state help text rather than the main copy.

maya: noted. i'll put the hint as secondary line: "Learn about scheduled jobs" with link.

maya: 3) archive model version confirmation modal: current primary copy is 'Archive version?'. that's terse and causes hesitation — users worry about deletion. can we reassure them in the brief copy?

conor: we should call out that it is reversible and will stop serving. proposed: "Archive this version? It will stop serving but can be restored later."

anya: maybe flip order for clarity: "Archive this version. It will be removed from live lists and stop serving. You can restore it later."

maya: that's longer but still okay for a modal. we should keep the primary sentence short and the second line explanatory. make the confirm CTA 'Archive version' and secondary 'Cancel'.

design-bot: accessibility note: confirmation modals must focus trap and read the full message on open. confirm button label should match action text in audit logs.

maya: good call. i'll keep the CTA text as 'Archive version' so it's logged consistently.

conor: tiny nit: for the 'restore' phrasing, use 'restore later' instead of 'can be restored later' for brevity.

maya: final modal copy: line1: "Archive this version." line2: "It will be removed from live lists and stop serving. Restore later if needed." CTA: "Archive version"

maya: will open three small PRs: tooltip + aria-label, empty state copy + hint link, modal copy + CTA tweak. est 40m.

design-bot: PRs created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3222 https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3223 https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3224

conor: thanks maya, i'll review the tooltip and modal copy. :thumbsup:
